import unittest
from tech_connector.dag_executor import DAGExecutor, Task


class TestDAGExecutor(unittest.TestCase):

    def test_cycle_detection(self):
        dag = DAGExecutor()
        task1 = Task('task1')
        task2 = Task('task2')
        task3 = Task('task3')
        task1.add_dependency(task2)
        task2.add_dependency(task1)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            dag.schedule([task1, task2])

    def test_deterministic_topological_scheduling(self):
        dag = DAGExecutor()
        task1 = Task('task1')
        task2 = Task('task2')
        task3 = Task('task3')
        task1.add_dependency(task2)
        task2.add_dependency(task3)
        dag.schedule([task1, task2, task3])
        self.assertEqual(dag.get_next_task(), task1)
        self.assertEqual(dag.get_next_task(), task2)
        self.assertEqual(dag.get_next_task(), task3)
        self.assertIsNone(dag.get_next_task())

    def test_bounded_concurrency(self):
        dag = DAGExecutor(concurrency=2)
        tasks = [Task(f'task{i}') for i in range(5)]
        for i in range(1, 5):
            tasks[i].add_dependency(tasks[i - 1])
        dag.schedule(tasks)
        self.assertEqual(dag.get_next_task(), tasks[0])
        self.assertEqual(dag.get_next_task(), tasks[1])
        self.assertIsNone(dag.get_next_task())

    def test_idempotency_key(self):
        dag = DAGExecutor()
        task1 = Task('task1', idempotency_key='key1')
        task2 = Task('task2', idempotency_key='key1')
        dag.schedule([task1, task2])
        self.assertEqual(dag.get_next_task(), task1)
        self.assertIsNone(dag.get_next_task())

    def test_retries_with_exponential_backoff(self):
        dag = DAGExecutor()
        task = Task('task', retry_count=3)
        task.mark_as_failed()
        with self.assertRaises(RuntimeError):
            dag.schedule([task])

    def test_cancellation(self):
        dag = DAGExecutor()
        task1 = Task('task1')
        task2 = Task('task2')
        task1.add_dependency(task2)
        dag.schedule([task1, task2])
        self.assertEqual(dag.get_next_task(), task1)
        dag.cancel_current_task()
        self.assertIsNone(dag.get_next_task())

    def test_compensation_rollback(self):
        dag = DAGExecutor()
        task1 = Task('task1')
        task2 = Task('task2')
        task1.add_dependency(task2)
        dag.schedule([task1, task2])
        self.assertEqual(dag.get_next_task(), task1)
        task1.mark_as_failed()
        dag.rollback_current_task()
        self.assertIsNone(dag.get_next_task())

    def test_pause_and_merge_context(self):
        dag = DAGExecutor()
        task1 = Task('task1')
        task2 = Task('task2')
        task1.add_dependency(task2)
        dag.schedule([task1, task2])
        self.assertEqual(dag.get_next_task(), task1)
        dag.pause_current_task()
        task1.merge_context({'new_key': 'new_value'})
        self.assertIsNone(dag.get_next_task())

    def test_invalidate_downstream_tasks(self):
        dag = DAGExecutor()
        task1 = Task('task1')
        task2 = Task('task2')
        task1.add_dependency(task2)
        dag.schedule([task1, task2])
        self.assertEqual(dag.get_next_task(), task1)
        task1.mark_as_failed()
        dag.invalidate_downstream_tasks(task1)
        self.assertIsNone(dag.get_next_task())

    def test_resume_from_checkpoint(self):
        dag = DAGExecutor()
        task1 = Task('task1')
        task2 = Task('task2')
        task1.add_dependency(task2)
        dag.schedule([task1, task2])
        self.assertEqual(dag.get_next_task(), task1)
        dag.pause_current_task()
        dag.resume_from_checkpoint()
        self.assertIsNone(dag.get_next_task())

    def test_recover_after_crash(self):
        dag = DAGExecutor()
        task1 = Task('task1')
        task2 = Task('task2')
        task1.add_dependency(task2)
        dag.schedule([task1, task2])
        self.assertEqual(dag.get_next_task(), task1)
        task1.mark_as_failed()
        dag.recover_from_crash()
        self.assertIsNone(dag.get_next_task())


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
